````text
# #1824: Patch: every "cards on the field" read sees a Unit a carrier holds, once
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

A unit riding on a carrier card is, by the rules, a real unit on the field: its text and aura keep working. But a dozen "every card on your field" readings were written before carriers existed and silently skip the riding unit — a "your Units on the field get +2" buff misses it while a "destroy all Units" hits it, plague counters placed on it go uncounted, and its cost aura goes dark while the stat-aura path still sees it. In two other places a unit standing in a backrow zone gets its text read twice. After this change all of these reads agree.

## Why

R446's contract (`crates/engine/src/carriers.rs:1-12`) is explicit: the carried Unit stands in the carrier's backrow zone "as a Unit for every rule ... its aura and its text keep working". The newer walks honour it — `targets::cards_in_scope_with` (`crates/engine/src/effects/targets.rs:383-396`) and `damage::acting_texts_of` (`crates/engine/src/damage.rs:159-180`) — but a family of older raw slot-walks drops `side.carried`:

- `effects/card_scope.rs:157-174` (`field_cards`) adds `standing_units_of` but never `carried_units_of`, while its comment claims parity with `cards_in_scope` — so `buffCards`/`grantKeywordCards` ("your Units on the field", e.g. shipped C+ #40 Appropriations) skip the riding unit.
- `crates/engine/src/plague.rs:35-64`: `carries_plague` admits a carried unit but `permanents_on_field` cannot enumerate it — counters placed on it are invisible to `plague_on_field`, and `exile_random_from` and `exile_all` disagree about "the field".
- `crates/engine/src/cost_rules.rs:104-124` (`acting_permanents` -> `cost_auras_for`): a carried cost aura drops out while `layers.rs:208` (`aura_sources`) still sees it — two aura reads disagree mid-play.
- More of the same shape: `graveyard_play.rs:56-83`, `query.rs:407-414`, `play_steps.rs:1992-2014`, `mana.rs:102-116`, the lasting-modifier and credit reads, `alt_play.rs`, `effects/radiant.rs:118-128`, `effects/fuse.rs:654-663`.
- The inverse bug: `draw.rs:307-323` and `multipliers.rs:41-46` seed with `active_units_of` (which already holds standing units) and then append every backrow top without the dedup `damage.rs:173-175` applies — a standing unit's hooks run twice per read.

Today only Ivory Tower (C+ #33) makes a carried unit, transiently inside its own play — but `carrier: boolean?` is in the custom-card kit (`crates/cards/luau/jackioh.luau:2182`), so a custom card makes the state persistent (§12), and every read above is reachable inside the shipped window: prompts and triggers open mid-play.

## Proposal

Promote one canonical enumerator — e.g. `zones::acting_on(state, player)` in R68 order (unit lanes, then carried, then standing, then backrow tops, each once) with the face-down/dormancy policy passed in — and convert the listed reads to it. Each fixed divergence gets a scenario test that fails today (a unit played onto Ivory Tower, the read exercised inside the window). Where a fix decides semantics the spec does not state, the change carries a ruling note per CLAUDE.md rule 3.

## Where it lands

`crates/engine/src/zones.rs`/`query.rs` plus the listed call sites, `crates/engine/tests/rules/` scenario tests, possibly `spec/rulings/`. SPEC §3.2 and §6.1 (Animated), R446, R68, R1081000.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] One shared enumerator exists and every listed walk goes through it or documents why it differs.
- [ ] "Your Units on the field" scopes reach a carried unit; the plague and field-exile reads agree with them.
- [ ] A standing unit's draw-limit and trigger-multiplier hooks run once per read.
- [ ] Each behavioural change has a failing-today test; any new semantic decision gets a ruling note and `cargo jackioh spec check` is green.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit` and `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` pass.

## Size and risks

Hard: ~12-15 call sites in one crate, each keeping its own dormancy predicate. The risk is over-unifying — `query.rs:465` (`lethal_attackers_of`) wants combatants, not "acting" cards — so the helper takes the policy as arguments instead of forcing one answer. A smaller first patch could take only the `card_scope`/`plague`/`cost_rules` fixes if the reviewer prefers.

---

/// Where `acting_on` lists a Unit standing in a backrow zone (R1081000).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum StandingAt {
    /// Among the side's Units, after its carriers' (R68's trigger order, `triggers::holder_sites`).
    AmongUnits,
    /// At its own backrow lane: the slot order a count, a pick or an offer has always walked.
    ItsLane,
}

/// R68, R446, R1081000, R1824000: every card acting on `player`'s side of the field, each once: each unit
/// zone's top in lane order, then the Units its carriers hold in backrow lane order, then each backrow
/// zone's top in lane order, a Unit standing there where `standing` puts it. Never a card dormant
/// beneath a pile (§3.2, R13). It reads no text: each caller drops what its rule says sleeps
/// (`preview::lasting_text_dormant`, `preview::is_face_down`). `layers::aura_sources` walks the same
/// `ItsLane` order straight off the rows (#188).
pub fn acting_on(state: &GameState, player: PlayerId, standing: StandingAt) -> Vec<&CardInstance> {
    let side = &state.players[player];
    let among_units = standing == StandingAt::AmongUnits;
    let mut out: Vec<&CardInstance> = Vec::new();
    for lane in 1..=UNIT_ZONES {
        if let Some(top) = lane_index(lane)
            .and_then(|index| side.units.get(index))
            .and_then(Option::as_ref)
            .and_then(|pile| pile.first())
        {
            out.push(top);
        }
    }
    out.extend(side.carried.iter().flatten().filter_map(Option::as_ref));
    if among_units {
        out.extend(standing_units_of(state, player));
    }
    for lane in 1..=BACKROW_ZONES {
        if let Some(top) = lane_index(lane)
            .and_then(|index| side.backrow.get(index))
            .and_then(Option::as_ref)
            && !(among_units && is_standing_unit(state, top))
        {
            out.push(top);
        }
    }
    out
}
```
````

```rust
            .and_then(Option::as_ref)

    }
```
